theme_and_archetype.description: A sophisticated, trustworthy finance app that breaks away from the generic 'tech-blue' and 'neon-dark' fintech tropes. It uses earthy, organic tones to evoke stability, growth, and calm.
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Grounded, matte, tactile, and highly legible. Focused on data clarity and user encouragement.

colors.guidelines: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use matte, solid backgrounds. Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for text. Use the 'Tinted Grey' rule: neutrals are slightly tinted green/warm.

typography.guidelines: Never use Inter. Maintain crisp legibility for numbers. Financial figures should use tabular lining if supported (e.g., 'tabular-nums' utility).

spacing_and_layout.system: 8pt grid system. Generous spacing (p-6, p-8) within cards. Dense mode only applied to the actual Expense List rows.
spacing_and_layout.mobile_container: Always wrap main content in a container that allows easy reading on mobile (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto for desktop viewing, w-full for actual mobile devices).
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Neumorphism & Soft Shadows. Use a 1px border (`border-border`) combined with `shadow-sm` on cards to ground them.
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Bottom Tab Navigation fixed to the bottom of the screen (`fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50`). 5 Tabs max: Home, List, Add (Prominent center FAB), Analytics, Settings.

icons_and_assets.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Consistent stroke width.

components.cards: Go mostly cardless for lists to maintain clean lines, but use Shadcn Card for summary blocks (Dashboard, Goals). Max 12px border-radius.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI Form, Input, and Select components. Large touch targets (min-h-[44px]).
components.buttons: Rounded-xl for primary actions. Use Primary color (#2C5545) sparingly, only for main CTA (e.g., 'Save Expense').
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs for switching between date periods (e.g., 'This Week', 'This Month'). Remove fixed heights from tablist.
components.badges: For gamification, use custom circular divs with pastel background + dark icon, avoiding generic stock photos.

charts_and_visualization.library: recharts (wrapped in Shadcn Chart if available)
charts_and_visualization.bar_chart: Per-category expense bar chart. X-axis: Categories. Y-axis: Amount. Include horizontal ReferenceLines for Min Goal and Max Goal (dashed lines, one green/safe, one red/danger).
charts_and_visualization.monthly_progress: A custom horizontal gauge or thick progress bar (h-6 rounded-full). Render three visual zones (0-Min, Min-Max, Over-Max) to quickly show where the user's total spend lies.

screens.Auth: Clean vertical stack. Large welcoming H1. Organic plant illustration above the login form. Standard Email/Password inputs (local offline mock auth).
screens.Dashboard: Top: Greeting + Avatar. Middle: Monthly Progress Gauge card (This month's spend vs goals). Below: Quick 'Recent Expenses' list (max 3 items). Bottom: Small horizontal scroll of 'Recent Badges Earned'.
screens.ExpenseList: Sticky header with Date Filter tabs. Clean, dense list rows with icon, description, date, and ZAR (R) amount. Tap row opens a Shadcn Dialog/Drawer with full details + photo.
screens.AddExpense: Full-screen form. Date/Time pickers (Shadcn Popover + Calendar). Category select. Toggle for 'Recurring'. Button for 'Add Photo' (mock camera/gallery interaction).
screens.Analytics: Segmented control for period (Week/Month/Year). Main Bar Chart showing categories with Min/Max threshold lines layered over it. Category totals summary cards below.
screens.Goals: Simple sliders + numeric inputs for Min Monthly Goal and Max Monthly Goal.
screens.Rewards: Grid layout of Badges. Locked badges are grayscale/muted. Unlocked badges use full color (Gold/Terracotta accents) with timestamps.
screens.Settings: List of actions: Manage Categories, Manage Recurring Expenses, Export CSV, Logout.

empty_state_illustration.description: Minimalist green plant growing. Use for 'No expenses yet' or 'Clean slate' empty states.

default_avatar.description: 3D cartoon avatar profile image for the Dashboard header.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 against backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY. All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, lists) MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-btn'`, `data-testid='add-expense-amount-input'`, `data-testid='expense-item-1'`).
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Use smooth, brief CSS transitions for hover states. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application feels like a native mobile app (use safe areas, bottom tab bar, no horizontal scrolling bugs). Ensure SQLite (or standard Web Storage / IndexedDB if adapted for web) is used for local persistence. Gamification logic should assign badges for first expense, staying under max goal for a week, etc. Do not use placeholder text or dummy URLs for images—use the ones provided.
